narrative.overview: A real native coding session stays primary. Filled graphite inspection regions and restrained blue focus make related state accessible without replacing Pi's transcript, editor or authorization lifecycle.
keyCharacteristics: Native character-cell panels, not a web dashboard.
Persistent context with a separate filled composer.
Shared keyboard/pointer inspection without a second conversation runtime.

rules.name: The State Rule
rules.body: Displaying progress, a tool result or a diff does not imply a passing gate, review or owner acceptance.

rules.name: The Continuity Rule
rules.body: Resize and inspection preserve draft, selected tab/file and bound session.

dos: Do preserve the real editor, transcript and bound identity.
Do show unknown, stale and unavailable state explicitly.
Do relocate metadata instead of hiding it on narrow terminals.
donts: Don't introduce a browser runtime or another agent loop.
Don't make local UI state look like canonical progress, evidence or authority.
Don't change native fonts or promise full terminal/accessibility certification.
